Name: (SHOP) The Voidwitch's Familiar
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿[i]
[quote]You've done quite a few feats in the valley, getting your grandpa's farm back into it's old glory, doing work for the community...one day among many, just like any other though, a letter reaches you from an unknown sender.

In it you're informed that someone will visit your valley, bringing certain goods...his name is Faust and he-...is unlike anything you've seen before. Will you risk it and buy from him?[/quote][/i]
Adds a new shop after you finished the community center(now alternatively: if you get the warehouse cutscene too) that is centered around selling 11 fall seeds, 23 new dishes and 1 scarecrow.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzBk4Tg2/title2-1-campatibility.png[/img]
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13497]SVR3[/url]﻿  ( unsure if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE [/url] but let me know if it is lol)!
